messages:
Julia: FinServe follow-up: they want a single-commit recommendation for multi-region chat (us-east + eu-west). Goals: p99 <250ms, 99.95% uptime, CMK + 30d audit. Can we sketch reserve vs hybrid and a quick runbook?
Sam: Heads-up: reserved GPUs are regional. For a pooled feel we do per-region reserves + routing with warm standby. Expect failover perf hit ~5-10%.
Priya: Ask them for traffic shape: 24h trace, peak/steady RPS, tokens/request, and %concurrent chat sessions. Without that, rough math: GPU_capacity ~= 8 tok/s (quant), so one GPU ~28k tokens/hr => estimate.
Julia: They gave a ballpark: peak 5k RPS, 80 tokens/req, proposed 40 GPUs.
Raj: Quick calc: 5k rps *80 = 400k tokens/s -> with 8 tok/s per GPU that is 50k GPUs (this indicates mismatch). Wait — re-evaluate units: 5k RPS (requests per second) *80 tokens = 400k tokens per second. If a GPU handles 8 tok/sec, we'd need 50k GPUs — implausible. Maybe they meant 5k RPS/min? Need clarification.
Priya: Good catch. Likely they mean 5k RPS as requests per minute or 5k concurrent users. We must validate. I'll ask for exact telemetry.
Julia: I'll clarify with FinServe.
Tina: Security: Dedicated/Private support CMK and audit logs. Hosted requires VPC/private plane and limited retention; will confirm.
cost-bot: Draft options: 40-reserved-hybrid-estimate_v2 ~ $122,000/mo internal. Assumes traffic is 5k RPS/min not/sec.
Sam: POC suggestion: 48h profiling with real traces + A/B quant vs fp16. Autoscale policy to show: reserved per-region, burst pool, prewarm slots (8), cooldown 30s.
Raj: I'll prepare KV replication notes for cross-region warm standby and list expected perf delta.
Priya: Also recommend a small synthetic load test during business hours to validate p99.
Julia: Action items: 1) clarify RPS units with FinServe, 2) request 24h trace + security form, 3) run 48h profiling once received.
Tina: I'll wait for the form; will flag any blocking CMK/regulatory needs.
Julia: Thanks all :thumbsup:
